newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mutual funds June inflow seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Italy mutual funds June inflow seen higher.

text.p: Italian investment funds were expected to show a total net inflow in June of over 7.0 trillion lire of which equity fund inflows would account for nearly 3.0 trillion lire, industry association Assogestioni said.
The monthly data are due to be published on Friday.
Assogestioni said in a statement that June inflows confirmed the extremely positive trend already seen for several months.
It noted in particular growing investor interest in specialised investment funds and in foreign stock funds.
In May, Italian investment funds saw a total net inflow of 5.709 trillion lire against 4.964 trillion in April, with equity fund inflows totalling 1.176 trillion lire against 768 billion.
